`final class Point`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.geom` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Point.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/geom/Point.java)

Immutable point of two or three `double` coordinates, compared by value.

## Description

Two points with the same coordinates are equal.
